name: 43229 · Columbus, OH
findings: ZIP 43229 (Columbus) has 228 nonprofit organizations. 97 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 79 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43229 (Columbus) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43229 (Columbus) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 79 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
